data.name: WPCA: World Phasebound Control Authority
data.detailed_description:
About the Game

"The world is not repeated. The mystery is not defined.
The growth does not communicate. The chaos is not aligned."

 

As a Containment Agent of the World Phasebound Control Authority (WPCA) Seoul Branch, you will stand against supernatural phenomena twisted into bizarre forms. Armed with the Core Interferometer, dive into the containment zones for the eternal safety of mankind!

Epic Boss Rush

  • Engage in fierce battles against Phasebound Horrors—anomalous entities that defy the very laws of modern logic and physical reality.

  • Experience raw catharsis as you overcome unpredictable threats and overwhelming scales.

Ultimate Stylish Action

  • Unleash spectacular maneuvers that tear through space and seize time itself.

  • Instantly exploit enemy weaknesses or drag massive beasts to your desired position to neutralize them.

Strategic Growth & Customization

  • Craft powerful Interferometer Weapons using remains salvaged from fallen monsters.

  • Build your ultimate combat loadout through a deep combination of weapon mechanics, skills, various passives, and randomized gear options.

Solo or Co-op Hunting (3-Player Co-op)

  • No need for pre-made parties or strict roles.

  • The only thing that matters is your performance on the battlefield.

  • Seamlessly switch between solo and co-op play to annihilate your enemies whenever you choose.

data.short_description: Step into the city's shadows as defenders against the paranormal. Your mission: Contain the Phasebound Horrors, the manifested fictions encroaching upon our world and the survival of humanity.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows®10 (64-bit Required)/Windows®11 (64-bit Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-10400 or Intel® Core™ i3-12100 or AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660(VRAM 6GB) or AMD Radeon™ RX 5500 XT(VRAM 8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD required. This game is expected to run at 1080p (upscaled from 720 native resolution) / 30 fps under the "Lowest" graphics setting. DirectStorage supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows®10 (64-bit Required)/Windows®11 (64-bit Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-10400 or Intel® Core™ i3-12100 or AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 2060 Super(VRAM 8GB) or　AMD Radeon™ RX 6600(VRAM 8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD required. This game is expected to run at 1080p / 60 fps (with Frame Generation enabled) under the "Medium" graphics setting. DirectStorage supported.
